description: DFX's own published research records and investigations: each finding with its permanent id, version, as-of date, denominator, method link, sources and citation line. With record_id, the evidence manifest: every claim with its basis (reported, DFX calculation, DFX inference) and source. A record with a correction pending has its statements withheld.

kind.description: original_finding: DFX computed or connected it. announcement_with_dfx_context: a third party announced it and DFX added context.

query.description: Words that must all appear in a finding's title, finding or categories (case ignored).

record_id.description: One research record id, DFX-RESEARCH-YYYY-NNNN: returns its entry and evidence manifest.

name: get_research_records
title: DFX's published research findings
